items.title: Heightened Import Disclosures for Supply Chain Visibility
items.summary: CBP is considering new requirements for visibility into the parties involved in importation, tracing technology for supply chains, and foreign export documentation — aimed at detecting illicit transshipment.

items.title: Accuracy of Importer of Record Data Submitted to CBP
items.summary: CBP's first public step implementing Executive Order 14411, ‘Strengthening Customs Enforcement’ — enhanced enforcement procedures targeting the accuracy of importer-of-record data on entry filings.
